views.label: Grading flow
views.note: A parent photographs a worksheet; the server fetches it back from Storage to send to Gemini for grading.

views.label: Data layer
views.note: Every write and every read passes through the Next.js server — the browser never talks to Supabase directly.

views.label: Practice writing
views.note: The one client-side call that skips the server: stroke data for the practice animation comes straight from hanzi-writer's CDN.

cards.title: Client
items: Camera capture with torch + ImageCapture fallback
Never calls Supabase directly — every request goes through the server
Exception: stroke-order practice fetches SVG data straight from hanzi-writer's CDN

cards.title: Server
items: 3 real API routes: upload, grade, credits top-up
Everything else is a Server Component reading data directly
Service-role key guarded by a server-only import at build time
Grading also persists each character's result to character_results before responding

cards.title: Data
items: RLS: public read, service-role write only
Storage bucket public — worksheet photos, not sensitive PII
Gemini returns a bounding box per character, drawn back as a red-pen overlay
Fourth table character_results stores that per-character verdict and box
